technology_name: Metal-Doped Polymer Composite for High-Performance Energy Storage Devices
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Synthesizing electrochemically active conducting polymer composites typically demands volatile co-solvents, secondary calcination steps, and leads to poorly dispersed metal oxide fillers.
description: An eco-friendly, ambient-temperature in-situ liquid-liquid interfacial polymerization process that synthesizes transition metal-doped manganese oxide ($MnO_2$) nanowire arrays seamlessly embedded within a poly(pyrrole) conducting matrix.
applications: Supercapacitor electrode design, next-generation lithium-ion battery anodes, electrochemical catalyst layers, and smart anti-static surface treatments.
